text: dsh-go-usage 是 DSH Web 插件，在页面浮层展示 OpenCode GO 订阅用量。它通过 shell.overlay 注册角落小组件，由 DSH 主机路由读取本机 OpenCode 凭据并请求用量接口。界面显示滚动、每周和每月用量百分比及重置倒计时，支持自动与手动刷新、收起展开，并跟随中英文界面语言。适合需要查看 GO 套餐额度的人；需要 Windows PowerShell 和已登录 OpenCode 的 GO 账号。

dsh-go-usage displays OpenCode GO usage in a DSH web overlay. It shows rolling, weekly, and monthly quota with reset countdowns, refreshes automatically or on demand, and can collapse to a tab. It follows the Chinese or English locale and uses local credentials with Windows PowerShell.
想在 DSH 页面角落看到 OpenCode GO 还剩多少用量。
有没有办法查看滚动、每周和每月的 GO 额度？
希望用量重置时间能显示倒计时。
让 DSH 定时更新 OpenCode GO 的用量状态。
我想在额度变化时手动刷新 GO 用量。
DSH 上能不能把用量面板收起来，需要时再展开？
Show my OpenCode GO quota in a corner of the DSH web page.
I want to see when my rolling and weekly usage resets.
dsh-go-usage 的功能「buckets」：用量面板分别展示滚动、每周和每月三个额度桶及其百分比；页面打开后自动获取当前数据。
dsh-go-usage 的功能「countdown」：每个用量桶同时显示距重置的倒计时，按当前中英文语言格式化，并每 15 秒更新显示。
dsh-go-usage 的功能「refresh」：组件每 60 秒自动重新加载用量，也提供刷新按钮立即发起请求。
dsh-go-usage 的功能「collapse」：点击收起按钮可把用量卡片变成右侧标签，再点击标签恢复完整面板。
dsh-go-usage 的功能「locale」：界面注册中文和英文文案，并读取 DSH 当前语言；语言改变时组件同步更新。
Reads local auth.json credentials and sends a request to opencode.ai; defaults to Windows PowerShell.

**dsh-go-usage** is a [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web plugin that shows your [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) **GO** subscription usage as a bottom-right corner widget: rolling / weekly / monthly usage percentages with reset countdowns, collapsible to a right-edge vertical tab.

dsh-go-usage README · dsh-go-usage：**dsh-go-usage** 是 [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的 Web 插件：在页面右下角以角标组件显示你的 [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) **GO** 套餐用量——滚动 / 每周 / 每月用量百分比与重置倒计时，可收起为右边缘竖条标签。

dsh-go-usage README · Features：- **Three usage buckets** — rolling / weekly / monthly, matching the OpenCode console page.
- **Progress bars** — color shifts to amber at 80% and red at 100% (rate-limited).
- **Live countdowns** — "Resets in X days X hours / X hours X minutes" ticking every 15 seconds.
- **Auto refresh** — re-fetches every 60 seconds; the ↻ button refreshes manually.
- **Collapsible** — the » button collapses the card into a slim right-edge tab; click the tab to expand.
- **Theme-aware** — follows the DSH theme: pure white in light mode, pure black in dark mode.
- **Bilingual** — copy follows the DSH locale setting: Chinese (滚动用量 / 重置于 X 天 X 小时) or English (Rolling usage / Resets in X days X hours), switching live.

dsh-go-usage README · Requirements：- Windows only (usage data is fetched via `powershell.exe`).
- Node.js >= 24, pnpm.

dsh-go-usage README · Prerequisites：- DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) installed — `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`
- An [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) account with an active **GO** subscription
- The `opencode-go` API key present in the local opencode auth file (set up by the OpenCode CLI):
  `%USERPROFILE%\.local\share\opencode\auth.json`

dsh-go-usage README · From npm：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-go-usage
```

dsh-go-usage README · From source / GitHub：```sh
git clone https://github.com/shsr07/dsh-go-usage.git
cd dsh-go-usage
pnpm install
pnpm build

> `link:` points at the local checkout — after editing, re-run `pnpm build` and restart the web service. You can also install straight from a git host: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:shsr07/dsh-go-usage#<sha>` (the package ships a `prepare` script that builds from source; allow the build when pnpm asks).
dsh-go-usage README · After installation：Restart the web service (`dsh web`), then look at the **bottom-right corner** of the page.

dsh-go-usage README · Configuration：All settings are optional; the defaults work out of the box. Add a `config:` block to the plugin row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` to override:

```yaml
- id: go-usage
  name: 'dsh-go-usage'
  config:
    authJsonPath: 'C:\Users\me\.local\share\opencode\auth.json'

dsh-go-usage README · Configuration：| Key | Type | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `authJsonPath` | string | `$USERPROFILE/.local/share/opencode/auth.json` (or `$HOME`) | Absolute path of the opencode `auth.json` containing the `opencode-go` API key. |
| `apiUrl` | string | `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage` | The OpenCode GO usage API endpoint. |
| `powershellExe` | string | `C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe` | The PowerShell executable the fetch runs. |
| `timeoutSec` | number | `15` | API request timeout in seconds (1–120). |

dsh-go-usage README · How it works：- The **host half** registers a fenced JSON route `/go-usage/api/usage` on the DSH web server. Each request runs one `powershell.exe` invocation: it reads the `opencode-go` API key from the local opencode `auth.json`, calls `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/usage`, and returns the parsed buckets. TLS 1.2 is enabled explicitly because Windows PowerShell 5.1 defaults to older TLS.
- The **browser half** registers the corner widget into the frame overlay (`shell.overlay`) and fetches the same-origin route every 60 seconds.
- The route is protected by the same trust fence as the DSH `/api` gateway (loopback Host header or the connection row's `trustedHosts`), so a cross-site page cannot reach it.

dsh-go-usage README · Privacy：- The API key stays on your machine: it is read from your local `auth.json` by the host process and never leaves it.
- Only the three usage percentages and reset timestamps are displayed; nothing is sent anywhere except the request to `opencode.ai` itself.
